paper: MENTOR: Human Perception-Guided Pretraining for Increased Generalization
verified_identity: Colton R. Crum and Adam Czajka; arXiv:2310.19545 (submitted 2023-10-30; v3 2025-04-26)
relevance_class: 强方法邻接：synthetic-face detection人工saliency预训练和CAM熵分析；非直接局部取证faithfulness验证
scope_and_methods: 全文核读。两阶段MENTOR先以autoencoder在无类别标签下预测人工显著图，再移除decoder并微调分类器；任务为iris PAD、synthetic-face detection和chest X-ray；10个随机seed测AUROC。Face任务使用363名Amazon Mechanical Turk参与者提供的real/fake判断及支持区域标注；训练样本765张（379 real/386 fake），20,000张验证样本。对比Cross-entropy、CYBORG、UNET+Gaze及不同backbone。
observed_reliability_evidence: 作者报告预测CAM的定性图例与test CAM salience entropy；将entropy作为显著图紧致/聚焦的粗代理，并把分析定位为synthetic-face explainability toolkit的一部分。其主实验展示saliency-guided pretraining与分类泛化，不是test explanation的独立真值判定。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: §6.2说明因时间限制仅计算S_entropy；作者承认已使用所有可用human saliency作训练，缺少额外数据以测model saliency与human saliency的效能差异。Entropy只量化紧致性，不能检验解释对模型决策的因果忠实性/局部篡改mask正确性；无用户解释效用或适当依赖实验。Face训练/验证规模及GAN数据域也限制外推。
screening_conclusion: 强方法邻接，纳入2023起synthetic-face explainability研究脉络。重要的是它明确显示‘saliency训练泛化’与‘saliency解释是否正确’是不同终点；保留作者的entropy代理并标明缺少独立human-ground-truth校验。

paper: Grains of Saliency: Optimizing Saliency-based Training of Biometric Attack Detection Models
verified_identity: Colton R. Crum, Samuel Webster, Adam Czajka; IEEE International Joint Conference on Biometrics (IJCB), 2024; arXiv:2405.00650
relevance_class: 强方法邻接：synthetic-face detection人类显著图训练与开集泛化；不是解释输出评价
scope_and_methods: 全文核读。研究iris PAD与合成脸检测；比较人工subjects、模仿人类显著性的autoencoder、领域分割模型，以及Boundary/Area/Features of Interest三档salience granularity；ResNet50、DenseNet121、Inception-V3；iris测试AUC跨3次、合成脸跨5次独立训练。合成脸测试集7,000张（1,000 real、6,000 StyleGAN系列合成脸）。
observed_reliability_evidence: 测量saliency来源与粒度对开集检测泛化的效应。synthetic-face结果显示不同架构的最优粒度不同、方差偏宽；这提示人类saliency监督在伪造检测中的效益并不稳定。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 所有主要结果是分类AUROC，不是模型解释与测试图像独立ground truth的对齐、必要/充分证据或模型参数随机化测试；human saliency被用作训练引导而非独立评价基准。只覆盖合成脸与生物PAD，不代表局部图像拼接/修补。
screening_conclusion: 强方法邻接；能支持人类显著监督、标签粒度、架构和跨训练seed的对比设计，不可将分类提升写作解释faithfulness或取证正确性。

paper: SAGE: Saliency-Guided Contrastive Embeddings
verified_identity: Colton R. Crum, Christopher Sweet, Adam Czajka; arXiv:2511.12744v2 (submitted 2025-11-16; revised 2025-12-05)
relevance_class: 强方法邻接：synthetic-face detection上的显著图引导训练与反转图sanity check
scope_and_methods: 全文核读。SAGE以saliency-preserving/degrading模糊增强、logit分布对齐和embedding triplet loss结合人类显著图；任务包含iris PAD、chest X-ray异常与synthetic-face detection；比较CYBORG、UNet+Gaze、Gaze-GNN、MENTOR等；5次独立训练，报告AUROC。附saliency-map反转sanity check。
observed_reliability_evidence: Synthetic-face ResNet50 AUROC：SAGE 0.587±0.060；将人类saliency map反转后0.577±0.037（差0.010）。该干预能有限检查训练收益是否对指定saliency输入敏感；其他任务的差异更大，任务效应不一致。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 研究目标是saliency-guided training的性能/机制，不是解释质量benchmark。合成脸结果较低且反转差异小，不能证明解释是正确/忠实；无真实篡改区域mask、独立证据真值、删除插入评测或用户适当依赖研究。作者把人工标注质量作为留待未来工作的问题。
screening_conclusion: 纳入合成脸解释脉络中少见的saliency反转sanity-check方法；审慎视为低幅度机制证据，不能等同完整faithfulness验证。

paper: Human-Aided Saliency Maps Improve Generalization of Deep Learning
verified_identity: Aidan Boyd, Kevin W. Bowyer, Adam Czajka; IEEE/CVF WACV 2022; arXiv:2105.03492; DOI 10.1109/WACV51458.2022.00132
relevance_class: synthetic/biometric spoof-detection method neighbor: human-saliency training; not explanation-validity evidence
scope_and_methods: Official WACV paper and arXiv abstract reviewed. Human annotations of salient iris PAD image regions are encoded through multilevel blur in a training-data transformation; compare against ordinary augmentation and a larger-data baseline, including leave-one-attack-type-out generalization.
observed_reliability_evidence: Reports lower LivDet-Iris 2020 winner error (29.78% to 16.37%) and improved generalization under unseen attack types. This is detector performance evidence, not an evaluation of post-hoc detector explanations.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: No image-manipulation authenticity task, explanation map ground truth, parameter randomization, deletion/insertion faithfulness, or human reliance endpoint. Human salience is training supervision.
screening_conclusion: Retain as early methodological context for human-derived region supervision; do not count as direct image-forensics XAI reliability evidence.

paper: Human Saliency-Driven Patch-Based Matching for Interpretable Post-Mortem Iris Recognition
verified_identity: Aidan Boyd, Daniel Moreira, Andrey Kuehlkamp, Kevin W. Bowyer, Adam Czajka; WACV Workshops 2023; DOI 10.1109/WACVW58289.2023.00077; arXiv:2208.03138
relevance_class: cross-domain forensic biometrics neighbor: localized evidence display and human evaluation
scope_and_methods: Official CVF WACV workshop full paper reviewed. Patch-Based Matching localizes usable iris texture in post-mortem images and displays corresponding matched regions. The paper includes two human annotation/comparison rounds (152 annotators in step 1; 131 in step 2) and reports human match/non-match accuracy as a design/evaluation comparator.
observed_reliability_evidence: The proposed output exposes local regions supporting match/non-match decisions; the authors explicitly design for human examiner understandability. Human study provides task-level performance evidence for forensic iris matching and visual annotation.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The decision is identity match between iris samples, not whether an image is manipulated/authentic. Region localization is a purpose-built matcher output, not post-hoc attribution faithfulness. Human comparison accuracy does not assess whether users appropriately rely on an XAI system.
screening_conclusion: Include as forensic-explanation and human-evaluation analogy, clearly separated from image forgery authenticity and post-hoc explanation validity.

paper: CYBORG: Blending Human Saliency Into the Loss Improves Deep Learning-Based Synthetic Face Detection
verified_identity: Aidan Boyd, Patrick Tinsley, Kevin W. Bowyer, Adam Czajka; IEEE/CVF WACV 2023; DOI 10.1109/WACV56688.2023.00605; arXiv:2112.00686; official CVF pages 6108–6117 (some early records say 6097–6106)
relevance_class: strong synthetic-face method neighbor: human saliency/CAM alignment in training
scope_and_methods: Official CVF page and PDF reviewed. 363 participants annotated salient regions while judging authentic versus synthetic faces; CAM is compared to human saliency in a training loss. Evaluation tests unseen GAN generators and multiple CNN architectures.
observed_reliability_evidence: Provides human-authored authenticity-region annotations and tests whether supervision improves open-set synthetic-face classification. It therefore offers a useful human-evidence source and a training alignment protocol.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Human annotations supervise training and are not an untouched test set for explanation validity. Reported gains are classification/generalization; no explanation sufficiency/necessity, model randomization, independent causal ground truth or appropriate-reliance study. Scope is fully synthetic face detection rather than local edits.
screening_conclusion: Strong method neighbor to synthetic-image authenticity explanation studies; not direct proof that generated explanations are faithful. Official CVF bibliographic pagination differs from some arXiv/reference-list metadata; canonical identity follows DOI/CVF.

paper: Teaching AI to Teach: Leveraging Limited Human Salience Data Into Unlimited Saliency-Based Training
verified_identity: Colton R. Crum, Aidan Boyd, Kevin Bowyer, Adam Czajka; BMVC 2023 (official proceedings), arXiv:2306.05527
relevance_class: strong synthetic-face/iris saliency training neighbor
scope_and_methods: Official BMVC 2023 page and full-paper content reviewed. Teacher models trained on limited human-saliency annotations produce CAM/RISE maps for larger student training sets; tasks include synthetic-face detection and fake-iris/PAD, evaluated across four CNN architectures.
observed_reliability_evidence: Shows student performance can improve when saliency generated from a human-guided teacher is used; the paper also discusses that a high-scoring teacher can attend to spurious image regions.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Main endpoint is classification AUROC/generalization. No independent test-time explanation ground truth, deletion/insertion, parameter randomization, adversarial explanation robustness or user reliance endpoint. A teacher’s saliency is pseudo-label supervision, not explanation truth.
screening_conclusion: Include as an important synthetic-face XAI-training lineage paper; no direct image-forgery explanation reliability evidence.

paper: Model Focus Improves Performance of Deep Learning-Based Synthetic Face Detectors
verified_identity: Jacob C. Piland, Adam Czajka, Christopher Sweet; IEEE Access 11:63430–63441 (2023); DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2023.3282927; arXiv:2303.00818
relevance_class: strong synthetic-face explanation proxy/entropy-method neighbor
scope_and_methods: Official arXiv HTML full text and IEEE DOI metadata reviewed. Proposes human-saliency-entropy-based, forced-minimum-entropy, DROID log-entropy, and combined CYBORG+DROID training losses; evaluates synthetic-face detection on unseen GANs.
observed_reliability_evidence: CAM entropy is used as a model-focus proxy. Results show lower entropy is associated with performance gains over part of the tested range, but the highest AUROC generally occurs around entropy 2.0–2.5 rather than at the minimum; blending human saliency and DROID slightly raises mean AUROC.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Entropy quantifies concentration, not relevance, causal faithfulness or evidence correctness. This is a training/performance study and does not validate post-hoc maps against independent authenticity annotations or test user reliance.
screening_conclusion: Important precursor to MENTOR/Grains/SAGE and to entropy-based saliency analysis; treat entropy as a proxy with a non-monotonic performance relationship, never as standalone reliability evidence.

paper: DiffGradCAM: A Class Activation Map Using the Full Model Decision to Solve Unaddressed Adversarial Attacks
verified_identity: Jacob Piland, Christopher Sweet, Adam Czajka; CVPR 2026 Findings; arXiv:2506.08514v4 (2026-04-09)
relevance_class: strong XAI reliability-method neighbor: adversarial robustness of CAM explanations
scope_and_methods: Official arXiv v4 full text and version metadata reviewed; CVPR 2026 Findings version identity confirmed. Proposes contrastive DiffGradCAM/++ using the target-vs-competitor logit difference and SHAMs, an entropy-aware passive-fooling benchmark. Experiments cover seven-class iris PAD (five DenseNet runs, human-salience vs SHAM supervision) and ImageNet (5,000 images, four CNN backbones); CAM susceptibility is normalized-map pixel MSE between clean and SHAM-fine-tuned models.
observed_reliability_evidence: On Iris PAD, SHAM-trained AUROC (0.9766±0.0018) is not lower than human-salience-trained AUROC (0.9723±0.0021), while GradCAM is qualitatively redirected. On ImageNet, mean-aggregated DiffGradCAM variants closely match standard maps in clean settings (MSE <1e-3); SHAM susceptibility is generally reduced but varies by architecture and CAM order, with other methods best/tied in some cases.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Map-MSE to GradCAM measures similarity to a baseline, not independent explanation truth; clean-vs-attacked map MSE measures resistance to this specified SHAM manipulation, not causal faithfulness or forensic localization. Insertion/deletion is explicitly judged unsuitable for this passive-fooling threat only. Authors state human studies would further validate utility; no user evaluation or appropriate-reliance outcome is reported. Iris PAD is a biometric presentation-attack task, not digital image manipulation detection.
screening_conclusion: Retain as high-priority general XAI robustness-method neighbor with direct relevance to adversarial reliability testing. Its evidence supports robustness under a defined model-manipulation threat, not global explanation correctness or direct image-forensics validity.

paper: Use HiResCAM instead of Grad-CAM for Faithful Explanations of Convolutional Neural Networks
verified_identity: Rachel L. Draelos, Lawrence Carin; arXiv:2011.08891v4; SAGE ref [12] preserves an earlier title/version in the same work cluster
relevance_class: strong general XAI faithfulness-method neighbor

screening_conclusion: Retain as a direct method-level faithfulness reference; cite the canonical v4 title and preserve the older bibliography title as a version alias.

paper: Explanations can be manipulated and geometry is to blame
verified_identity: Ann-Kathrin Dombrowski et al.; NeurIPS 2019; official proceedings PDF
relevance_class: strong general visual-XAI reliability-method neighbor: explanation manipulation and robustness
scope_and_methods: Official NeurIPS full text reviewed. Optimizes visually small input perturbations so explanations approach a selected target while the full model output stays approximately constant; studies six explainers, VGG-16/ResNet-18/AlexNet/DenseNet-121 and ImageNet/CIFAR-10, then analyzes equal-output manifold geometry and tests explanation smoothing.
observed_reliability_evidence: Across 100 randomly selected images per explanation method, target maps are closely reproduced while perturbation images and model outputs remain highly similar; reported median output-vector difference is about 10^-3. Smoothing increases robustness for gradient- and propagation-based explanations.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: This is a controlled general vision robustness attack/defense study, not image-forgery detection. Robustness to targeted input-map manipulation does not establish map correctness, localization faithfulness on authentic/tampered images or appropriate human reliance.
screening_conclusion: Strong transferable method neighbor for adversarial input perturbation and robustness tests. Keep separate from direct forensic evidence studies.

paper: Fooling Neural Network Interpretations via Adversarial Model Manipulation
verified_identity: Juyeon Heo, Sunghwan Joo, Taesup Moon; NeurIPS 2019; arXiv:1902.02041v3
relevance_class: strong general visual-XAI reliability-method neighbor: adversarial model manipulation
scope_and_methods: Official arXiv v3 full text reviewed. Fine-tunes VGG19, ResNet50 and DenseNet121 by combining classification loss with explanation penalties, defining passive fooling (uninformative location/top-k/center-mass maps) and active fooling (cross-class explanation swaps); evaluates Grad-CAM, LRP and SimpleGrad with Fooling Success Rate on ImageNet validation examples.
observed_reliability_evidence: The paper reports fooled maps generalize over the validation set and transfer across interpreters, while Top-1/Top-5 accuracy falls by about 2%/1%. FSR is thresholded by design, so it measures success relative to specified attack targets rather than explanation truth.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: General ImageNet explanation attack/robustness methodology, not image-authenticity or local tampering detection. Does not validate explanations against independent causal or forensic region ground truth, nor test human reliance.
screening_conclusion: Strong method neighbor for model-manipulation stress tests; complementary to Dombrowski input attacks and DiffGradCAM passive-fooling robustness, but not direct forensic evidence.

paper: Improving the Interpretability of GradCAMs in Deep Classification Networks

paper: The Perceived Fragility of Explanations in Audio Models: Manipulation of Attribution with Unchanged Predictions
verified_identity: P. Kitłowski, D. Wiącek, M. Modrzejewski; arXiv:2606.14466v1, 2026-06-12
relevance_class: 跨模态解释脆弱性邻接：音频deepfake检测；非图像取证直接研究
scope_and_methods: arXiv官方全文核读。用SONICS中100段随机音频测试VGGish、AST、SpecTTTra-gamma-5s；Grad-CAM/LRP；攻击包括L∞PGD、适配X-Shift及心理声学掩蔽噪声，约束检测预测不变；计算解释余弦/Top-10重叠和Audio Fragility Score，并报告PEAQ、ViSQOL、Zimtohrli、CDPAM、PESQ、STOI等客观感知指标。
observed_reliability_evidence: 作者报告可在预测和客观感知质量大体保持时显著改变归因；模型脆弱性有架构差异，AST更易受影响，SpecTTTra较稳健。
